lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
The ground is shaking under immense flame
The heavens tremble at his name
The king of glory rides the sky
With hosts of light which never dies
Steel on stone and thunder rolls
The shepherd calls his scattered souls
The sky ignites with crimson's fire
The nations fall, their thrones expire
He stands where ancient prophets cried
The lamb who lives, the one who died
With righteous wrath his sword descends
He breaks the chains, he loves his friends
Yahushua, lion of the last battle
Breaking every earthly shackle with truth unbound
And eyes that blaze, you tear the night with holy rays
Captain of the skies, fire engulfing in your eyes
Every fortress, great and small, falls before the King of all
His banner raised above the field
His covenant the only shield
The wicked flee before his blazing sight
The humble rise to join the fight
He thunders justice from His throne
The world laid bare, His glory shown
And every knee will bow in awe
Before His everlasting love
Yahushua, Lion of the last battle
Breaking every earthly shackle
With truth unbound and eyes that blaze
You tear the night with holy rays
Yahushua, captain of the skies
Fire engulfing in your eyes
Every fortress, great and small
Falls before the King of all
The army's marching, perfect line
Moon doesn't shine
Stars fall back, sun resigns
His name resounds across the plain
The victor crowned forever reigns
Glory, glory, Yahushua
Lead us all to Zion's door
Yahushua, Yahushua
Lion of the last battle
Breaking every earthly shackle
Your roar commands the stormy air
Your truth consumes all dread and snare
Yahushua, captain of the skies
Flames engulfing in your eyes
Every kingdom's pride will fall
But you remain the Lord of all
And when the final trumpet cries
The King will stand before the earth's eyes
The war is won, the shadows flee
For Yahushua is the victory
